data.name: Telling Blow
data.description: You can aim your blows at the weakest point in a studied foe's defense, ignoring up to 5 points of damage reduction. This does not apply to damage reduction without a type, and cannot be used against creatures that are immune to critical hits or otherwise lack discernible weak points. This ability stacks with the Penetrating Strike feat.
